provenance_resolution.evidence: Disk mtime 2026-10-25 01:03:55 demonstrates target/release/j2me-cli was never rewritten during the 7,300 configuration run. All child processes spawned by PID 66864 executed the exact binary 75321b0d2942bd9389f6cda7cc27786c5ed3f4449751ce4e5b6c4436e422ba43.

root_causes_addressed.impact: Eliminated cascading NullPointerExceptions caused by 'Object' string fallback and un-prefixed package-relative asset paths in games like MicroCombat.

Added checked i64 arithmetic preventing multiplication overflow on signed scanlength; added byte[] grayscale/RGB332 overloads; mapped Nokia bitmasks (4096, 64, 512, 128, 1024, 2048) and Gameloft literals (4444, 565, 8888).

Reconciled game_canvas_buffers, graphics_contexts, and images during mark-and-sweep GC. Verified unreferenced GameCanvases release backing buffers and prevent native memory growth across multiple allocation cycles.
Differentiated active rendering (GameCanvas.flushGraphics) from passive Canvas.paint(Graphics). Terminated false NO_PAINT labeling on actively rendering games.
